_doc: Fixtures for .harmony/probe-deck-clock.sh (s-rta-0926b plan4 item 2: decks that are not on screen keep time; plan4-final.md section 3.6). @MEDIA@ is replaced at run time with the checkout's media/ dir. JSON enum ints: Clip MediaType Image 1 / Video 2 / ImageSequence 5 (Clip.h:21), TransportMode Timeline 0, LoopMode Loop 0 (Clip.h:116/:118), AutopilotAction PlayNext 2, AutopilotDuration Beat4 3 (Clip.h:146-160). A clip's 'speed' key is loaded unguarded (Clip.cpp:214) -- every video/sequence clip here sets it to 1.0. Assertions + calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-deck-clock.py.

fade._why: deck 0 L0 transitionSpeed T (a duration, s), col0 = A, col1 = B. Trigger col1 (A -> B fade), leave the deck 0.3 s later: the fade must keep running and be complete when you come back.

single_advance._why: deck 0 layer id 5 Transparent fading col0 -> col1 over T while deck 1 is shown: advanced once per frame (a double advance reads ~1.0 at T/2). Was the 'persistent' fixture: the layer JSON still carries persistent=true, which bf9 Stage P ignores.

pending._why: deck 0 col1 has beatSnap: its trigger is queued; leaving the deck cancels it (L5). Four injected beat crossings later deck 0 must still be on col 0.

video._why: ramp12.mp4: 12 s, 320x240, 30 fps, frame mean G = 255 * t / 12 (t = 12 * meanG / 255, +-0.15 s). Away 4 s: the playhead must be ~4 s further on return.

sequence._why: ImageSequence [A, B] at 0.5 fps (2 s per frame, 4 s loop): 0.5 s in (showing A), away 2 s, back 0.3 s -> t ~= 2.8-3.4 s -> frame 1 = B. A frozen sequence resumes at ~1 s -> still A.

autopilot._why: deck 0 L0 autopilotEnabled, cols A B C each Beat4 / PlayNext; trigger col0, leave, 6 injected beat crossings (beatPhase 0.99 / 0.01, 100 ms apart): deck 0 must have advanced to col >= 1.

hitch._why: deck 0 L0 = ramp12_1080.mp4 (1920x1080, GOP 60); away 5 s; the return frame's catch-up decode runs inside compositeDeck (inside frame_time_ms). REPORT; FAIL above render2's 50 ms bar.
